destinationObjects.name: Ukraine Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2025

flows.description: In 2022, Ukraine launched the humanitarian initiative "Grain from Ukraine" to export grain to countries facing food shortages, especially in Africa and Asia. The program is based on the direct purchase of agricultural products from Ukrainian producers by the countries participating in the project and their transportation to countries facing food shortages or famine. So far, more than 30 countries and international organizations have joined the initiative, through which Ukraine, in cooperation with the World Food Program, has sent more than 170 thousand tons of wheat to countries affected by food insecurity, including Ethiopia, Somalia, Yemen, Nigeria, Sudan and Kenya. The program is planned to be expanded to Mozambique, Malawi, Madagascar, Djibouti, Liberia, Mauritania, Lebanon and other countries.
